_comment: Curated mappings from a Helix career to an NHS Health Careers role page.
These produce a LINK ONLY. NHS England reserves all rights in the content at
healthcareers.nhs.uk and its terms limit use to personal viewing, so Helix
reproduces none of it. The same terms explicitly permit linking, which is
Key   = the Helix career title as title_matcher.normalise() produces it.
Value = the final path segment of the role page URL, for example
